opportunity.title: Financial Management Software and Support Services (RFI)
opportunity.description: Request for Information only, for market research, issued by the First Responder Network Authority (FirstNet Authority). The government is seeking responses from entities able to provide financial management software and support services, and will use responses to decide the acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. Amendment 002 extended the response date to October 26, 2026. Amendment 001 clarified the number of users for market research pricing. The contemplated NAICS code is 541519 Other Computer Related Services; Information Technology Value Added Resellers.

profile._note: FICTIONAL SAMPLE COMPANY for scenario testing. Not a real firm. Past performance and staffing are invented; only the NAICS codes, set-aside definitions and every opportunity and award figure used against it are real public data.
profile.name: Atlas Federal Systems Inc. (sample)
profile.pastPerformance: Large business. Eleven DoD and civilian IT prime contracts between $5M and $60M, including a Defense Health Agency data program.
profile.capacityNotes: About 400 staff, 150 cleared. Facility clearance (Top Secret). FedRAMP Moderate. Not eligible for any set-aside.
verification: NAICS codes confirmed against USAspending reference (api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/references/naics) on 2026-10-16.
Set-asides follow SBA definitions: SBA = small business, 8A = 8(a) Business Development, HUBZONE, WOSB/EDWOSB, SDVOSB.

checks.reason: Full and open competition; no set-aside required.
NAICS 541519 is in the company's codes.
Place of performance VA is within the company's coverage.

The notice seeks information on financial management software and support services under NAICS 541519 with no set‑aside.
The FirstNet Authority states the RFI is for market research only and does not constitute a solicitation or commitment to contract.

rationale.point: The RFI has no set-aside and aligns with the company's NAICS 541519, making the large business eligible to respond.
The notice is explicitly for market research only and does not constitute a solicitation or commitment to contract, so responding is low-risk but offers no guarantee of future work.
The FirstNet Authority (within the Department of Commerce) issued the Sources Sought, confirming a genuine government requirement for financial management software and support services.

risks: RFI may not lead to a follow-on RFP or contract award.
Competition from other large businesses with similar IT and financial management capabilities.
Specific requirements and evaluation criteria are unknown at this stage.
nextSteps: Assess internal financial management software and support service capabilities against the RFI description.
Prepare a response highlighting relevant past performance (e.g., DoD/civilian IT prime contracts $5M-$60M, data programs).
Monitor for any subsequent solicitation from the FirstNet Authority or Department of Commerce.
